en.title: Halo: Campaign Evolved Finally Arrives July 28 for Xbox, PS5, and PC
en.summary: The iconic Halo campaign is getting a complete remake with Halo: Campaign Evolved, launching later this summer. Players can expect a modern take on the seminal shooter experience, with enhanced features and expanded content.
en.body:
The wait is nearly over for fans eager to revisit the birth of a legend. **Halo: Campaign Evolved**, a ground-up remake of the story component of the original 2001 masterpiece, is officially set to launch on **July 28, 2026**. This highly anticipated title will be available across **Xbox Series X|S, PC, and PlayStation 5**, bringing the Master Chief's first adventure to a new generation of consoles and a wider audience than ever before.

Developed by the newly rebranded **Halo Studios**, formerly a restructured team within the franchise's ecosystem, **Halo: Campaign Evolved** promises to be more than just a graphical facelift. The remake is built from the ground up, reimagining the genre-defining campaign with modern sensibilities. Players can look forward to new missions that expand upon the established narrative, alongside enhanced gameplay mechanics that respect the core experience. For those who cherish the cooperative spirit of Halo, the game will feature two-player split-screen co-op on consoles, and online and networked co-op for up to four players across both console and PC. Seamless cross-platform play with shared progression is also a key feature, ensuring a unified experience regardless of platform.

This ambitious project marks a significant moment for the Halo franchise, moving away from the proprietary Slipspace Engine and focusing on delivering a definitive campaign experience. The original **Halo: Combat Evolved**, developed by Bungie, set a new standard for console shooters and laid the foundation for one of gaming's most beloved universes. This remake aims to recapture that magic while introducing it to players who may have missed the initial phenomenon.

## A Definitive Return to the Ring

The announcement has generated considerable excitement within the Halo community. Many players grew up with the original campaign, experiencing the thrill of discovering Installation 04 alongside the Master Chief and Cortana. The promise of new missions and expanded gameplay, coupled with modern co-op features, suggests that **Halo: Campaign Evolved** is not just a nostalgic trip but a substantial new entry designed to engage both longtime fans and newcomers. The inclusion of cross-platform play and shared progression is a particularly welcome detail, addressing a key demand from the player base for a more connected experience across all available platforms.

## What's Next

Pre-orders for **Halo: Campaign Evolved** are available now, with Standard, Premium, and Collector's Edition options to choose from. Early access begins on **July 23, 2026**, for those who opt for the premium editions, giving them a five-day head start on the adventure. The full release date is confirmed for **July 28, 2026**, across all specified platforms.
